Chapter 156 - 156 I'Ll Buy It; Level 6!

Chapter 156 - 156 I'll Buy It; Level 6!

156 I’ll Buy It; Level 6!

The group of four went through every corner of Modu and inspected more than ten office buildings.

Every time they came out of an office building, they would take notes and write down their comments.

After all, this concerned their future career development, so they were very cautious.

Of course, only Lin Fan was relaxed.

He just treated it as accompanying Qin Yuxuan to go shopping.

When they came out of an office building again, they went to the beverage shop next door and sat down.

Senior Fan took out a stack of documents, wrote a few words, and analyzed, “The location of Defense Office Building and Xinmei Building is not very good. Let’s put them aside for now.

“The location of Tianpu Building is not bad. However, there’s no common area, so we won’t be able to use it…

“Triumph Building is a little old…

“The Magnificent Hotel is also relatively old…”

…

Senior Lu, who was at the side, looked at the office buildings that were constantly being passed. She let out a long sigh and said, “If we have money, it would be best to open an investment company in the Global Financial Building!

“The location and environment are all first-class! At the same time, we can also display our strength! In the future, we’ll definitely get twice the result with half the effort!”

When Senior Lu mentioned the Global Financial Building, her eyes seemed to sparkle, and her tone became high-spirited.

“Oh?” Lin Fan asked. “Then go straight for the Global Financial Building.”

Senior Fan pushed up her glasses and said, “Don’t even think about the Global Financial Building. The price is several times that of other places. The annual rent for a small office might cost millions.”

Lin Fan said, “Let’s go take a look first.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he held Qin Yuxuan’s hand and was about to walk out.

Senior Lu and Senior Fan thought that Lin Fan wanted to go for a walk, so they did not object and followed him.

After all, the Global Financial Building was a good attraction for outsiders in Modu.

After Lin Fan walked into the Global Financial Building, he went straight to the marketing center.

After he briefly explained the situation, the salesperson brought everyone to the 78th floor.

This was a large office of 500 square meters. Through the translucent floor-to-ceiling windows, one could see the Pujiang River that was as bright as the Milky Way under the sunlight. There were also skyscrapers that rose and fell, and people the size of ants…

It could be said that the beautiful scenery of the entire Modu was captured in their eyes.

In this place, if one was tired from work or encountered something that did not go their way, all of one’s fatigue and worries would probably disappear if one looked into the distance, right?

This was a form of enjoyment!

It was an ultimate enjoyment that made one feel relaxed and at ease!

Senior Lu, Senior Fan, and Qin Yuxuan’s eyes were lit up by the distant sunlight, and their faces were filled with yearning.

Seeing this…

“We’ll buy this office,” Lin Fan said to the salesperson beside him.

“Huh?” The salesperson was stunned.

Senior Lu and Senior Fan did not quite understand.

Qin Yuxuan wanted to stop Lin Fan.

Seeing that the salesperson did not reply, Lin Fan could not help but ask again, “Why? Can’t I buy it?”

“O-Of course, you can…” After hearing Lin Fan’s affirmation, the salesperson finally reacted.

Then, he carefully sized up Lin Fan from top to bottom.

He was not being snobbish.

It was because the price of an office in the Global Financial Building was too expensive.

To be able to rent an office here was already considered very powerful.

As for buying?

That would be too difficult.

“The average price of this office is 185,000 yuan per square meter. It’s 500 square meters in total. The total price is… 92.5 million yuan.”

Lin Fan took out his bank card and said, “Alright, swipe my card.”

“Uhh… Sir, please come with me to the marketing center downstairs. We’ll draw up a contract for you, and then… Then, we’ll determine the exact price.”

The salesperson stuttered for a while before slowly explaining the steps of purchasing.

He had not prepared the contract beforehand.

He had not even prepared a rental contract, let alone a purchase contract.

This was because too many people came to see their offices every day.

However, there were very few people who actually rented one.

The rent of the offices in the Global Financial Building was too expensive.

To buy an office directly?

That was a small probability that would only happen a few times a year.

Soon, everyone returned to the marketing center.

The contract was quickly printed out.

Lin Fan flipped through the contract page by page.

In just ten seconds, he signed his name at the bottom right corner of the contract.

This made the salesperson stunned again.

Was he not afraid that there would be problems with the contract?

This was a deal that involved nearly a hundred million yuan!

However, he did not know that Lin Fan had the scanning ability. He could read all the contents of the page in one glance.

He could even recite it word for word.

Beep!

Lin Fan swiped his bank card on the machine.

The bill slowly appeared. The transaction was successful!

Senior Lu and Senior Fan looked at the contract in Lin Fan’s hands and were stunned.

What was going on?

Where were they?

What were they doing?

From the moment Lin Fan walked into the Global Financial Center to the moment he signed the contract and made the payment…

How long did it take?

Including the time they took the elevator, it probably did not even take more than 10 minutes, right?

He bought an office worth nearly 100 million yuan within ten minutes?

Senior Fan and Senior Lu felt that everything was so surreal as if they were in a dream.

However, Lin Fan did not care too much about it.

[Ding! Do you want to use the 10x spending return card?]

“Yes!”

Not long after, Lin Fan’s phone vibrated.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 925 million yuan was deposited into your account.]

He spent 92.5 million to buy an office.

Then, he earned 925 million yuan?

At this point, Lin Fan’s cash reserves had reached 1.28 billion yuan!

Even Lin Fan, who obtained so much cash in one go, could not help but smile.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s mind rang out with a crisp notification.

[Ding! Hidden mission completed: own more than one billion in funds. Reward: ten silver packets.]

[Ding! System upgrade: LV6!]

[Level 6 reward: 50 yuan for every breath; 50 yuan for every second of sleep, and 50 yuan for every step taken. Rewards are distributed at 12 a.m. daily.]

At Level 5, he could earn a minimum of 1.4 million yuan per day.

Now, the total money he could earn from this method had increased by 2.5 times!

In other words, he could earn 3.5 million yuan every day!

[Upgrade cost: 52.8 million/100 million (not including gifts and gambling. In addition, all items obtained from the system are prohibited from being traded.]

[Ding! The check-in system has been activated. Note: You can sign in once a day. You’ll receive different rewards.]

As Lin Fan listened to the notifications in his mind, the smile on his face grew wider.

Spending 92.5 million to buy an office was worth it!
